nodes.description: TellorStorageStruct.uintVars mapping holding global protocol parameters (stakeAmount, disputeFee, stakerCount, total_supply, targetMiners, etc.)
Checkpoint balance history mapping address => Checkpoint[] used by TellorTransfer
ERC20 allowance mapping address => address => uint256
Mapping address => StakeInfo tracking staking status and start date
Mapping requestId => Request holding mined values, timestamps and dispute flags
Mapping disputeId => Dispute holding tally, votes and payout data
Mapping dispute hash => original disputeId, used to link dispute rounds
Mapping requestQ index => requestId
uint256[51] array of top requests ranked by payout
Details[5] array of currently submitted mined values
Mapping bytes32 => address storing owner, deity, tellorContract addresses
Constant bytes32 key keccak256("stakeAmount") used to index uintVars
msg.sender - externally controlled caller address used for authorization, balances and staking
block.timestamp (now) - miner-influenceable time value used for voting/withdraw windows and fees
TellorTransfer.transfer: transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to
TellorTransfer.transferFrom: transfers using allowance, decrements allowance then moves tokens
TellorTransfer.approve: sets allowance for _spender
TellorTransfer.doTransfer: validates and updates both balances at current block
TellorTransfer.balanceOfAt: binary search of checkpoint history for a block balance
TellorTransfer.allowedToTrade: checks tradeable balance, subtracting stake if staked
TellorTransfer.updateBalanceAtNow: pushes or updates the current-block checkpoint
TellorDispute.beginDispute: opens a dispute against a mined value and collects the fee
TellorDispute.vote: casts a weighted vote on an open dispute
TellorDispute.tallyVotes: tallies votes, locks staker status or signals fork
TellorDispute.proposeFork: charges fork fee and creates a fork proposal dispute
TellorDispute.updateTellor: swaps tellorContract address after a successful fork vote
TellorDispute.unlockDisputeFee: slashes/returns stake and disburses dispute fees per round
TellorDispute.updateMinDisputeFee: recomputes disputeFee from stakeAmount, targetMiners and stakerCount
TellorStake.init: bootstraps supply, constants and the initial 6 staked miners
TellorStake.requestStakingWithdraw: locks a staker for withdrawal and decrements stakerCount
TellorStake.withdrawStake: releases stake after the 7-day lock elapsed check
TellorStake.depositStake: stakes msg.sender and refreshes the dispute fee
TellorStake.newStake: validates balance/status and registers a new staker
TellorStake.getTopRequestIDs: resolves the top-5 requestQ entries to requestIds
SafeMath.add: checked addition (uint256 and int256 overloads)
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction asserting b <= a
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with overflow assertion
doTransfer: previousBalance - _amount unchecked raw subtraction before balance write
doTransfer: previousBalance + _amount addition before balance write
allowedToTrade: balanceOf(self,_user) - uintVars[stakeAmount] raw subtraction
transferFrom: allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount allowance decrement
requestStakingWithdraw: uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 raw decrement
unlockDisputeFee: uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 raw decrement on slash
beginDispute: fee computed as stakeAmount * disputeCount or disputeFee * dispRounds
vote: disp.tally add/sub of converted voteWeight (int256/uint256 casts)
withdrawStake: now - (now % 86400) - stakes.startDate timestamp-based lock check
updateMinDisputeFee: stakeAmount*(min(targetMiners,stakerCount)*1000)/targetMiners /1000 arithmetic
tallyVotes: (total_supply * 10) / 100 fork-pass threshold arithmetic with uint cast of int tally
Parameter _amount of TellorTransfer.transfer
Parameter _to of TellorTransfer.transfer
Parameter _spender of TellorTransfer.approve
Parameter _user of TellorTransfer.allowedToTrade
Parameter _requestId of TellorDispute.beginDispute
Parameter _timestamp of TellorDispute.beginDispute
Parameter _minerIndex of TellorDispute.beginDispute
Parameter _disputeId of TellorDispute.vote
Parameter _supportsDispute of TellorDispute.vote
Local _fee computed in beginDispute and passed to doTransfer
Local voteWeight in vote derived from balanceOfAt
Local dispRounds in beginDispute driving fee multiplication and execution date

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only meaningful as the transferred quantity inside transfer
_to is the recipient parameter consumed directly by transfer
_spender is only used to key the allowance write in approve
_user is only used to read balances/stakerDetails inside allowedToTrade
_requestId is only used to index requestDetails within beginDispute
_timestamp is only used to select the mined value inside beginDispute
_minerIndex selects the miner slot and fee branch inside beginDispute
_disputeId is only used to load the Dispute struct in vote
_supportsDispute only chooses the tally add or sub path in vote
_fee is the direct product of the beginDispute fee multiplication operation
voteWeight is cast and applied to the tally inside the vote tally operation
dispRounds is a direct multiplier operand of the beginDispute fee computation
